verdict.rationale: Docs confirm an API platform secured by mTLS and OAuth 2.0, and an MCP server enabling agents to act on financial data, but there is no evidence of a mechanism to issue scoped or least-privilege API credentials/tokens specifically for an agent (e.g., limited-scope API keys, per-agent OAuth scopes, or role-restricted MCP credentials). Card spend limits address employee card controls, not API credential scoping.
